notes.title: Hotfix - 0.0.2
notes.content:
A new hotfix is now live with a number of adjustments and bug fixes based on recent feedback and reports.

[b]General[/b]
- Resolved an issue where music would occasionally not play correctly.
- Gnomes will no longer spawn a tombstone after being destroyed, since they were causing some issues (we will work on getting them back!)

[b]Enemies[/b]
- Fixed a bug where enemies that had been Stomped would sometimes not be able to get up.

[b]Combat Trial[/b]
- Increased the thickness of the magic barrier in the Combat Trial to prevent enemies from passing through.

[b]Bootcamp[/b]
- Fixed a couple visible gaps in the walls.

[b]Items[/b]
 The following items can now be picked up:
- Spoon
- Plate
- Bowl
- Ham slice

Fruit crates will now correctly spawn the following grabbable items:
- Apples
- Cheese
- Ham
- Mushroom

Additional grabbable items:
- Coins from Piggybanks
- Cauldron from the Hero Pitstop


Thank you again for your continued support and feedback - it helps us track down these issues and improve the experience for everyone! Please keep letting us know if you encounter any further problems.

notes.title: Hotfix - 0.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Known issue: [/b]

top of each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840280/8a112f3039f40a3b589f48cbfb4b3d03da9b6a3e.png[/img]

[h3] Some general FAQ’s for launch [/h3]

[b]When will the game launch?[/b]
[list]
[*] The game will go live on the 22nd of May at 6 PM CET, 12 PM EDT, 12 AM CST (23rd).
[/list]
[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
[list]
[*] During the Early Access period, the game will cost approximately $12.49 USD.
[*] There will be a 20% launch discount for the first 2 weeks.
[/list]
[b]What will the Early Access build include?[/b]
[list]
[*] The first world of Glum’s journey where you will find wacky enemy interactions, goofy collectibles, trials, a main hub and much more. You can expect around 1-3 hours of gameplay at launch for the story mode. 
[*] An Arena Mode that UNLOCKS after completing the story mode. Arena Mode is a wave-based combat arena, where you have to clear 20 of increasingly more difficult waves, where you can practice your combat skills!  
[/list]
[b]When can we expect the first major update?[/b]
[list]
[*] We are aiming for Summer 2025, but is subject to change depending on community feedback.
[/list]
[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]
[list]
[*] During Early Access we will be implementing new biomes, enemies, abilities and systems based on our internal roadmap as well as community feedback.
[*] With every major update, the game will increase significantly in content and playtime.
[/list]
[b]What are some of the bigger changes since the Steam Next Fest Demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] A brand new wave-based combat Arena Mode! 
[*] The entirety of the first level is available with objectives and a new companion has been added to increase narrative coherence.
[*] Boot cosmetics and progression system for future ability and basic combat enhancements.
[*] New exploration elements, tweaks and polish based on user feedback.
[*] A new wacky boss fight.
[*] And much more.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840280/840c3f229ddaa162c28d09c06398ab12306dd168.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update – Save Data Fix (we gave it the boot)
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Goblin Gang[/b]!

First off, massive [b]boot salute[/b] to [b]@Dynamo[/b] on our Community Discord for spotting a sneaky little bug skulking around. Turns out, some old save data was lingering like a chicken ready for the kick, refusing to let you experience the fresh, crispy content we lovingly prepared for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. Unacceptable.

Now, despite the flu currently speedrunning a 100% completion run on Team CinderCat, we mustered up our goblin strength, sniffled our way through the code, and kicked that bug straight into oblivion. That means[b] you’ll now load into the right level every time[/b], so you won’t accidentally miss out on, say… a certain mysterious church  👀

⚠️ [b]Heads up![/b] This fix means your game data will [b]reset ONCE[/b] after updating. It’s a one-time boot to the system, and after that, your progress will save properly, and you’ll be back to wreaking havoc in no time!

Thanks for being the [b]best damn community out there[/b], helping us fine-tune the madness that is GLUM. Keep those bug reports coming, and as always…

Happy kicking 🧡

[b]Team CinderCat [/b]

notes.title: GLUM is joining Steam Next Fest 🤘
notes.content:
[h3][b]Boots strapped?[/b][/h3]
Good, because we’ve got something special brewing for all you goblin-loving gamers (and those who are a little goblin-curious). GLUM is officially joining Steam Next Fest with a demo packed with even more chaos, style and mischief than before 💥​

This isn’t just any demo, cause this is one shaped by YOU. Thanks to all the amazing feedback from our playtests and the Discord community, we’ve been hard at work refining, tweaking, and adding even more ways to cause mayhem 🤘


[h3][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/h3]
😈 [b]Brand New Menace System[/b] - Earn style points for creative kills! Whether you’re flinging explosive barrels and magical potions at your enemies, or getting up close and personal, the game now rewards your flair for destruction!

⚔️ [b]Kick-Ass Physics Combat[/b] - Our physics-based combat system ensures that every enemy you take down reacts dynamically, meaning glorious, over the top ragdoll chaos. Smash, launch, and obliterate foes in ways that are as satisfying as they are hilarious.

🎉 [b]Wacky Exploration & Collectables[/b] - We’ve added even more of GLUM’s crude humor to the environment, making those hidden spots and cheeky collectables worth every moment of exploring!

📖 [b]Tutorial Tweaks[/b] - Our tutorials have gotten a facelift! Minor fixes, tutorial videos and clearer wording now make it even easier for you to become the menace you were always meant to be.



We can’t wait to see how you handle the mayhem and hear what you think! But [b]don’t miss out[/b] - the demo is [b]ONLY [/b]available during Steam Next Fest, February 24th - March 3rd.


👉 Wishlist GLUM, join our Discord and mark your calendars today!

notes.title: Devlog 1 - What's been brewing
notes.content:
Hey Goblin Gang!

We thought it might be nice to know a little about what we’re working on behind-the-scenes, so we’ll try to put out a few short devlogs when we’ve go interesting stuff to share!

Ever since the demo was released, we’ve been hard at work assessing some of the feedback we’ve received from you guys - and while we appreciate the feet pics, it is [i]“feedback”[/i] and not [i]“feetback”[/i]…

So now that’s in the clear, let’s bring you up to speed on what’s been happening here at the “Bootcamp”.

We’ve had a lot of focus on really bringing out the menacing parts of our combat, while also trying to up the Action-feel of GLUM, so we’re currently testing the following:

[b]We’ve upped the pace of combat by quite a bit.[/b]
[list]
[*] Glum is faster with shorter cooldowns
[*] Enemies die faster, and there are a lot more of them (like, A LOT)
[*] Encounters have a lot more environmental dangers for you to take advantage off
[/list]

[b]We’ve also worked on a “style system”, which rewards players for being a real menace![/b]
[list]
[*] This system rewards more points by more difficult and menacing actions
[*] It has cool/funny/edgy/cringey names for actions (a lot of puns)
[*] A highscore will in fact give you bragging rights over your less skilled pals - [b]dev-confirmed[/b]
[/list]

As we’re still ironing out some of the kinks, we’ll be looking for testers over at our Discord server, so if you’re interested in following along, please join the Goblin Gang over there!

Thanks for following along!
All the best,
- No, Creative Director

notes.title: 🎉 GLUM Speedrunning Spectacular 🎉
notes.content:
Hey GLUM-sters! Get ready to kick it - literally - because we’re hosting our very first Parkour Challenge Speedrunning Competition! 💨

📅 [b]When:[/b] Wednesday, November 27th, 2024

⏰ [b]Time:[/b] 7 PM - 9 PM CET

📍 [b]Where:[/b] On the [url=https://discord.gg/xhh3tq9MQS]GLUM Discord Server[/url]


[h3]🥳 What’s Happening?[/h3]
Strap on your goblin boot and join us GLUM-devs for an epic night of speedy goblin shenanigans. You’ll tackle the Parkour Time Trial Challenge from our demo (so make sure you’ve reached that part of the demo beforehand) in two thrilling categories:

1️⃣ [b]In-Bounds Race[/b] (play it clean, no tricks!)

2️⃣ [b]Out-of-Bounds Race[/b] (bend the rules, if you dare!).


[h3]🏆 Prizes[/h3]
Like with any good competition, there will be more to gain than honor…

[b]Category Winners [/b]
💸 A Steam Gift Card 
🏅 The Special Champion Server Rank: “Blazing Boot” 

[b]Speedy Achievers[/b]
Complete a specific time  (32 sec for In-Bounds or 20 sec for Out-of-Bounds) to unlock the server rank “Speedster” - because your goblin greatness deserves recognition!

So whether you’re a boot-launching legend or just here to cheer on the chaos, this is your night to shine! 

📣 Spread the word to friends and foe, practice your parkour, and we’ll see you in the GLUM server on November 27th!

notes.title: NEW LOOK - SAME GLUM!
notes.content:
🔥 NEW LOOK, SAME GLUM 🔥

Hey players! We’re stoked to reveal that our guy Glum has had the glow-up of a teenager who just discovered Accutane ✨ We’ve ditched the subtitle A Wicked Misadventure, so now it’s just GLUM - short, sweet, but as twisted as ever. 😈

We’ve slapped on some eye-popping colours, made a new logo that brings out the “wawaweewa” in every Borat enthusiast, and created key art that’s hotter than a dragon’s butt cheeks 🐉🔥 

It’s the same messed-up world we love, just with a fresher vibe.

Get ready for more weirdness, coming soon! 🤘💥

notes.title: Glum is part of Women's Day Steam Feature!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that we’re now live on the Women’s Day Steam Feature by WINGS! 🎉

As an Indie Developer, being part of any Steam Feature is always a great and valuable experience - but seeing Glum amongst so many cool games made by women-led studios adds another level of proudness. Games and game development is for everyone, and that’s a message we’re proud to support at CinderCat Games.

As for the development of GLUM, we’re currently cooking up a lot of new features, which really bring out the grumpy and menacing demeanor of this particular goblin. We’re super excited about the direction we’re taking GLUM, and we can’t wait to start revealing even more of what’s the come within the next years time! 🔥

This game development journey has had a lot of ups, downs and curveballs for us as a studio - but through it all, GLUM has developed into a seriously wacky, fun and unique game, which we are beyond excited to get to show you more of 💚

And as always - make sure to go wishlist Glum: A Wicked Misadventure!

notes.title: Game Demo out on G.Round
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840280/310f33b89742b084a5bc075f941c53870e62a1ab.png[/img]

You heard us. Until August 30th you can play the ‘_Final_FINAL_ForReal’ version of the [b]Glum: A Wicked Misadventure[/b] demo - our game all about the grumpy goblin Glum who is sent out on a mission to save his Evil Overlord, armed with only his bad temper and a magical boot ✨

We’ve partnered up with the people at [i]G.Round[/i] to make Glum available on their testing platform - so now is your chance to play a game about mishandling anger management issues, kicking some medieval ass and maybe even flipping ‘em off whilst doing so (hey, we just give you the tools - you’re the one deciding how to use them).

We’d love to hear how you, as a player, experience Glum, and what kind of constructive feedback you can provide us with, in order for us to strengthen the game and make it the best it can be. Besides feedback, we’d also love for you to throw [b]ANY[/b] ideas you have at us. We are still in pre-production, which means that we’re actively designing new aspects of the game and iterating on existing choices, so [i]your idea[/i] might very well end up in the game! 🌟

The game is playable with a controller, but for the best experience, we recommend using keyboard and mouse.

Anyway - enough talk about kicking ass, let’s just get right to it! We hope you enjoy the game and want to share any feedback and ideas with us here on Steam, on G.Round or even on our Social Media 🔥

Best,
The CinderCats
